en-US.summary: Ask what is wrong with a service, then approve or reject the fix.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask fleet ops what's wrong with payments
Alexa, ask fleet ops to approve
Alexa, ask fleet ops to reject
en-US.name: FleetOps
en-US.description: FleetOps investigates one service on Fleet Commander and waits for approve or reject. It uses the same agent as the board.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill and say what's wrong with payments. Then say approve or reject. The endpoint is https://yn6f6qpstp.us-east-1.awsapprunner.com/alexa.
